items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And he said, bring me four pieces to the, I forget the name of it, the place, ....

ctx.x: Yes. BUSY or something. And so Bootsy asked me he said, hey, man, where are you going with those drums? I said, I'm going home. He say, oh yes, he said, where have you been working?
I told him Tom's Road House, see? He said, well, why did you leave? I say, for fighting. And he said, bring me four pieces to the, I forget the name of it, the place, ....
Orchard Cabaret? No. With Papa Celeste and Big(Archie?)
